output.reason: The brief is persuasive because it cites specific audit-trail evidence (39 of the 41 "late" RFIs were still Callerby drafts, and CO-09 was issued after the crane had already left), and its next steps are clear and well hedged; it is less firm on how much of the delay CO-09 actually justifies, and on how Kestrel's early-handover incentive fits into the internal side.
